svg.title: We ran the map: a looming shadow turned our simulated fly away in 4 of 4 runs, scrambled map 0 of 3. Digital Fly Lab, 5 Oct 2026
svg.desc: We ran the map. A looming shadow on one eye turned our simulated fly away in 4 of 4 runs. With the same map scrambled (same number of connections per neuron) it turned away in 0 of 3. Here the map's wiring, not the stimulus or our code, makes the turn. One model (Shiu et al. LIF on FlyWire v783), open loop, our hand-made mapping, a constant external walking drive, 1 s; not a real fly. Small n: 4 real and 3 scrambled runs (pre-registered time limits); the scrambled brains were much quieter and no activity-matched scramble was run; the direction "away" rests on our mapping's DNa02 sign and fly67's claim; the direction in real flies was not verified by us.
svg.text: DIGITAL FLY LAB · OUR OWN TEST · 5 OCT 2026
We ran the map.

away in 4 of 4 runs. With the same map scrambled
(same number of connections per neuron) it turned
